summary: Executed isolated backend verification for owner recovery/readiness plus shared auth/people/rates regression and mobile-web login smoke. Found one code bug in replay bookkeeping and one production-readiness blocker (old build endpoint missing).

critical.issue: After simulated crash post-user-update, replay completion revokes newly issued sessions; expected behavior is to finish bookkeeping without revoking fresh sessions.
Returns 404 in production read-only probe; indicates production still on older build without /api/health/live.

minor.issue: Default /opt/plugins-venv pytest environment missed motor dependency; tests executed with /root/.venv pytest instead.

integration_issues.issue: Supervisor expo logs repeatedly show unauthorized origin from https://app.emergent.sh.

action_items: Fix replay path in shared/admin_recovery.py so completion after interrupted apply does not revoke newly issued session families.
Deploy owner-recovery/readiness build to production app; verify /api/health/live exists and returns 200.
Apply private production settings on app+website (STAFF_SERVICE_KEY and website canonical/integration keys/origins) via authorized operator.
Re-run isolated replay test and production read-only health probes after deployment/settings update.

rca_of_issue: Replay bug reproduction: (1) Start owner as CUSTOMER in isolated DB. (2) Dry-run obtain report hash. (3) Apply with monkeypatched complete() raising after user role/session_version update. (4) Old token already fails (expected via session_version increment). (5) Issue fresh OTP session. (6) Re-run same approved operation to complete bookkeeping. Observed fresh session becomes invalid (401), showing replay completion revoked all session_families. Mitigation: make replay completion idempotent without global family revoke when role/event already applied and post-recovery sessions may exist.
